description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and React component helpers for a 3D rendering library built on three.js and React, including scene graph management, camera updates, and event handling.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: React component that catches JavaScript errors in its child component tree and sets an error state.

methods.name: findInitialRoot
methods.description: Returns the outermost root store of a given instance.

methods.name: act
methods.description: A React testing utility for flushing async effects, deprecated in favor of React's built-in act.

methods.name: isOrthographicCamera
methods.description: Type guard to check if a camera is THREE.OrthographicCamera.

methods.name: isRef
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a React RefObject.

methods.name: isColorRepresentation
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a valid THREE.ColorRepresentation.

methods.name: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
methods.description: Custom hook that uses useLayoutEffect on the client and useEffect on the server.

methods.name: useMutableCallback
methods.description: Hook that returns a ref to a callback function, updating it on each render.

methods.name: useBridge
methods.description: Creates a React component that bridges context and strict mode for a renderer.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Component that blocks rendering and sets a promise-based state.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary
methods.description: React component that catches errors in its children and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: calculateDpr
methods.description: Calculates device pixel ratio, defaulting to 2 in browsers.

methods.name: getRootState
methods.description: Retrieves the root state from a THREE.Object3D instance.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Creates or updates an instance descriptor for a scene object.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a key path within a root object, supporting pierced keys.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a child instance to a parent based on attach property.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches a child instance from its parent.

methods.name: diffProps
methods.description: Computes the difference between current and new props for an instance.

methods.name: applyProps
methods.description: Applies a set of properties to a THREE.js object, updating event handlers and other attributes.

methods.name: invalidateInstance
methods.description: Requests a re-render/update for a scene instance.

methods.name: updateCamera
methods.description: Updates camera parameters based on size and type.

methods.name: isObject3D
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a THREE.Object3D.
